mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. We have clear skies and a temperature of 49 degrees at Verona City Hall, with a New Moon gracing the night. Expect an overnight low of 36 degrees with no rain in the forecast.
In local news, there are no new updates or emails from the city to share with you today.

For those looking to get out and about, Bailey's Run is hosting live music today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, or catch trivia nights at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's this Tuesday.
In our weekly report, there were no police incidents documented, so it has been a peaceful week in Verona.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Snickers Swirl. The shop is currently open, so feel free to head over and grab a scoop before they close their doors at 10:00 PM.
